title: Implement index UI for columns
description: Create the UI for adding indexes to columns on a table, documenting query performance considerations.
acceptanceCriteria: User can add an index to a column
Index is visually associated with the table
Index is recorded in the diagram model

evidence: Index UI already fully implemented in codebase (from STORY-007, done): src/types/diagram.ts (Index type, table.indexes array, createIndex helper), src/hooks/useDiagram.ts (addIndex/removeIndex/updateIndex), src/components/TableNode.tsx (IX badge, indexes section, add/edit/remove index UI), src/index.css (index badge, indexes section, index edit row styles), DiagramCanvas.tsx/App.tsx wiring via onTableUpdate→updateTable.

All 3 acceptance criteria verified: AC1 'User can add an index to a column' — + Add index button opens name input + column select + Save; AC2 'Index is visually associated with the table' — IX badge on indexed columns + dedicated indexes section; AC3 'Index is recorded in the diagram model' — indexes stored in table.indexes[], removeColumn cleans up referencing indexes.

Containerized test run: docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 512 --memory 2g --shm-size 1g --user 1000:1000 --tmpfs /tmp -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -v $(pwd):/work -w /work node:20-alpine sh -c 'npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test' — 283/283 tests passed across 26 test files. Index-specific tests: TableNode.test.tsx (IX badge, indexes section rendering, add/remove/edit/cancel index) and useDiagram.test.ts (add/remove/update index).

TypeScript check: no errors in ticket-related files (TableNode.tsx, TableNode.test.tsx, useDiagram.ts, useDiagram.test.ts, DiagramCanvas.tsx). All tsc errors are pre-existing in unrelated files (diagram-model.test.ts, readSchemaApi.test.ts, CreateRelationshipModal.test.tsx, DdlPreview.tsx, ddlGenerator.ts).
Branch ticket/TASK-019 is identical to origin/main (git diff empty); no code changes needed — implementation already complete and merged from STORY-007.
No platform skips required — all tests are Node.js/jsdom unit tests running on Linux in Docker.
